title: 第0025章凰溪暗流初试心灵眼第0026章地底猫影交易花呗呗
content_zh:
;;
夜色如墨，泼洒在凰溪岛度假区的海岸线。
白日里人声鼎沸的滨海武道广场，此刻只剩下昏黄的路灯投下拉长的影子，海风卷着咸腥气掠过空旷的训练场，刮得地面上散落的气血测试单哗哗作响。贾黑米攥着口袋里皱巴巴的预选准考证，缩在广场角落的健身器材后，尽量让自己融入这片无人问津的黑暗里。
距离凰溪岛武道高考预选，还有最后三天。
整个岛屿的少年武者都在疯了一般冲击气血阈值，街头巷尾随处可见扛着负重狂奔的身影，武道馆里气血激荡的轰鸣声从早响到晚，就连度假区最豪华的温泉疗养区，都被各大世家子弟包下，用来辅助气血修行。
唯独贾黑米，像个局外人。
他低头看着自己摊开的手掌，掌心苍白，没有半点武者该有的殷红气血光泽，手腕上的便携式气血仪跳动的数字，始终停留在97——距离武道预选最低及格线100点，还差整整3点。
三点。
看似微不足道，却像一道天堑，横在他和“武者”这个身份之间。
三年来，他试过了所有能找到的底层修行法，啃过最劣质的气血丹，睡过武道馆后门的石阶，每天凌晨五点就跑到海边扎马，可他的气血就像被一只无形的手按住，无论怎么挣扎，都突破不了百点大关。岛上的人都叫他“凰溪废柴”，连武道馆的扫地大爷，都敢在他背后指指点点，说他就是个浪费灵气的废物。
“97点……再练一百年，也考不上预选吧。”
贾黑米自嘲地笑了笑，指尖划过冰凉的金属器材。他是个孤儿，从小在凰溪岛的贫民区长大，没有家世背景，没有修行资源，连最基础的武道教材，都是从垃圾桶里捡来的旧书。如果不是三年前灵气复苏的余波波及到凰溪岛，他连成为武者的资格都没有。
可现在，他连最基础的预选门槛，都摸不到。
海风突然变得阴冷起来。
不是海边正常的凉意，而是一种像从冰窖里钻出来的、带着黏腻恶意的寒气，顺着衣领钻进骨头缝里，让贾黑米忍不住打了个寒颤。他皱起眉，抬头望向广场对面的凰溪假日酒店——那是岛上最顶级的武者度假酒店，此刻灯火通明，不少世家子弟正在顶层的观景台修行，气血光芒透过玻璃窗，在夜空中划出一道道淡红色的轨迹。
按理说，那里是气血最浓郁的地方，不该有这么重的阴寒之气。
可那股寒气，偏偏就是从酒店方向飘过来的。
更诡异的是，贾黑米的耳朵里，突然钻进了一阵细碎的、模糊不清的声音。
不是风声，不是海浪声，也不是武者的交谈声。
那声音像是无数人在耳边低声呢喃，沙哑、干涩、带着一种能勾动人内心最深处绝望的韵律，断断续续，却又无比清晰：

“放弃吧……你就是个废物……永远成不了武者……”
“气血永远上不去……预选一定会落选……一辈子待在底层烂掉……”
“不如就这样倒下……永远沉睡……就不会痛苦了……”
【心灵低语！】
贾黑米的瞳孔骤然收缩，浑身汗毛瞬间竖起。
他在旧武道教材里见过这个词——灵气复苏百年，蓝星不止诞生了气血武道和序列异能，还伴随着一种名为“诡异”的恐怖存在，它们以人类的负面情绪为食，通过心灵低语侵蚀武者的心智，轻者气血紊乱、走火入魔，重者直接发狂，变成六亲不认的怪物。
教材里说，心灵低语只有被侵蚀的武者才能听到，可他明明只是个气血97点的废柴，连正式武者都算不上，怎么会听到这种东西？
更奇怪的是，那低语声虽然刺耳，却并没有像教材里描述的那样，让他心生绝望，反而让他的脑海里，升起一股极其微弱、却异常清晰的清凉感。
就像一滴冰水，滴进了滚烫的油锅里。
嗡——
贾黑米只觉得眉心一阵轻微的发麻，眼前的世界，突然变了。
他看到假日酒店的方向，笼罩着一层肉眼看不见的、浓黑如墨的雾气，那雾气像活物一样扭动、翻滚，不断朝着广场上的少年武者飘去。凡是被黑雾碰到的少年，脸色都会瞬间变得苍白，眼神里透出迷茫和痛苦，气血仪上的数字开始疯狂波动，有的直接从120点暴跌到90点，有的甚至浑身抽搐，倒在地上抱头惨叫。
“那是……心灵侵蚀的本源？”
贾黑米瞪大了眼睛，不敢相信自己看到的一切。
他能看穿那层遮蔽常人视线的诡异黑雾，能看清黑雾里无数细小的、像虫子一样的诡异能量，正顺着人类的毛孔，钻进他们的心灵深处。而那些细碎的低语声，正是从这些黑雾里传出来的。
这就是三天前，叶利西老人说的——心灵破障天赋。
三天前，他在海边修行时晕倒，醒来就看到了那个穿着灰色布衣、眼神深邃得像星空的百岁老人。老人没说太多，只是拍了拍他的肩膀，留下一句“你的眼睛，能看见别人看不见的地狱”，然后就消失在了树林里。
当时他只当是个疯老头，可现在，他终于明白老人话里的意思。
他的眼睛，能窥见邪神的低语，能看穿心灵侵蚀的本质！
“住手！”

The night is like ink, splashing on the coastline of Huangxi Island Resort.
In the Binhai Martial Arts Plaza, which was bustling with people during the day, now only the dim street lights cast long shadows. The sea breeze carried the salty smell across the empty training ground, making the Qi and blood test sheets scattered on the ground rattle. Jiahemi clutched the crumpled pre-selection admission ticket in his pocket and huddled behind the fitness equipment in the corner of the square, trying his best to integrate himself into this unattended darkness.
There are still three days left before the preliminaries for the Huangxi Island Martial Arts College Entrance Examination.
The young warriors on the entire island are hitting their qi and blood thresholds like crazy. Figures running with heavy loads can be seen everywhere in the streets. The roar of qi and blood in the martial arts hall can be heard from morning to night. Even the most luxurious hot spring health care area in the resort has been reserved by the children of major aristocratic families to assist in qi and blood cultivation.
Only Jiahemi looked like an outsider.
He looked down at his open palms, which were pale and devoid of the bright red qi and blood luster that a warrior should have. The portable qi and blood meter on his wrist always kept the beating number at 97 - 100 points away from the minimum passing line for martial arts preliminaries, which was still 3 points away.
Three o'clock.
It seems insignificant, but it is like a natural chasm between him and his identity as a "warrior".
In the past three years, he had tried all the low-level cultivation methods he could find, chewed the poorest quality Qi and Blood pills, slept on the stone steps at the back door of the martial arts gym, and ran to the beach at five o'clock in the morning every day to do horse training. However, his Qi and blood seemed to be held down by an invisible hand. No matter how hard he struggled, he could not break through the hundred-point mark. People on the island called him "Huangxi loser", and even the sweeper of the martial arts hall dared to point fingers behind his back, saying that he was a waste of spiritual energy.
"97 points... If I practice for another hundred years, I won't be able to pass the preliminaries."
Jiahemi smiled self-deprecatingly and ran his fingertips across the cold metal equipment. He is an orphan who grew up in the slums of Huangxi Island. He has no family background and no training resources. Even the most basic martial arts textbooks are old books picked up from the trash can. If the aftermath of the resurgence of spiritual energy three years ago hadn't spread to Huangxi Island, he wouldn't even be qualified to become a warrior.
But now, he can't even touch the most basic pre-selection threshold.
The sea breeze suddenly became cold.
It was not the normal coolness at the seaside, but a sticky and malicious coldness that seemed to come out of an ice cellar. It penetrated along the collar and into the seams of the bones, making Jiahemi couldn't help but shiver. He frowned and looked up at the Huangxi Holiday Hotel opposite the square - it was the top warrior resort hotel on the island. It was brightly lit at the moment, and many disciples of aristocratic families were practicing on the observation deck on the top floor. The light of energy and blood penetrated the glass windows, drawing light red tracks in the night sky.
Logically speaking, that is the place where the qi and blood are the strongest, and there shouldn't be such a heavy cold air.
But that cold air came from the direction of the hotel.
What was even more strange was that a thin, vague sound suddenly entered Jiahemi's ears.
It was not the sound of wind, nor the sound of waves, nor the sound of warriors talking.
The voice was like countless people whispering in their ears. It was hoarse, dry, and carried a rhythm that could evoke the deepest despair in people's hearts. It was intermittent, but extremely clear:
"Give up... you are just a waste... you will never become a warrior..."
"The blood will never improve...you will definitely fail in the pre-selection...you will stay at the bottom and rot all your life..."
"It's better to just fall down like this...sleep forever...then there will be no pain..."
【Mind whispers! 】
Jia Heimi's pupils suddenly shrank, and the hairs all over his body stood up instantly.
He had seen this word in old martial arts textbooks - after a hundred years of spiritual energy recovery, Blue Star not only gave birth to Qi and blood martial arts and sequence powers, but also was accompanied by a terrifying existence called "weird". They feed on human beings' negative emotions and erode the minds of warriors through spiritual whispers.Fire becomes a demon, and in severe cases, it goes crazy and turns into a monster that no one can recognize.
The textbook said that the whispers of the soul can only be heard by warriors who have been corroded, but he is obviously just a loser with 97 health points, and is not even a formal warrior. How can he hear such things?
What was even stranger was that, although the whisper was harsh, it did not make him despair as described in the textbook. Instead, it gave him an extremely weak but extremely clear sense of coolness in his mind.
It's like a drop of ice water dripping into a boiling pan of oil.
Buzz——
Jia Heimi only felt a slight numbness in the middle of his eyebrows, and the world in front of him suddenly changed.
He saw that in the direction of the Holiday Inn, there was a thick, black mist that was invisible to the naked eye. The mist twisted and rolled like a living creature, constantly drifting towards the young warrior in the square. Any boy who was touched by the black mist would instantly turn pale, with confusion and pain in his eyes. The numbers on the blood meter began to fluctuate wildly. Some plummeted from 120 points to 90 points. Some even twitched all over and fell to the ground holding their heads and screaming.
"Is that...the source of spiritual erosion?"
Jiahemi's eyes widened and he couldn't believe what he saw.
He could see through the layer of strange black fog that obscured ordinary people's sight, and he could see clearly the countless tiny, insect-like strange energies in the black fog, which were following the pores of human beings and drilling into the depths of their hearts. And those tiny whispers came from the black mist.
This is what old man Ye Lixi said three days ago - the talent of breaking spiritual barriers.
Three days ago, he fainted while practicing at the beach. When he woke up, he saw the centenarian man wearing gray cloth and his eyes as deep as the stars. The old man didn't say much, just patted him on the shoulder, left a message, "Your eyes can see the hell that others can't see", and then disappeared into the woods.
At that time, he just thought he was a crazy old man, but now, he finally understood the meaning of the old man's words.
His eyes can glimpse the whispers of evil gods and see through the nature of spiritual erosion!
"stop!"
